title: feat: safe program starts, owner push yes and fewer false holds
headline: Every program the installed kit starts by name now starts from node's own folder, so a git.exe or gh.exe left in a project never runs; an owner push past the bound needs the owner's pop-up yes; sweep reviewers read the rules from the merge base; on Windows the guard start script finds git again; and several harmless reads the guards held now pass.
alignment: v1.49.0 is build 23a of the v2.0 plan: K250 first, then K209, K212 to K215, K211, R7.1 with K224, K217, K243, K244, K218, K210, K207, K208, K204, K251, K226 to K229, K241, K242, K252, K154 and K186, each reproduced on the released 1.48.0 or proven by a failing test first.

items.text: On Windows the guard start script left the launcher no git, so a project with git's worktree config on had every tool call held; the launcher now gets Git for Windows' own folder, never the session's PATH.
items.test: tests/guards-outside.test.mjs::the guard start script lets the launcher find git, never a git planted on the session PATH (K250)

items.text: One safe-spawn helper starts every installed kit launch (git, gh, ps) from node's own folder, with a time limit, so a git.exe or gh.exe left in a project never runs.
items.test: tests/safe-spawn.test.mjs::the helper starts every program from node's own folder, hidden, with a time limit, and git on the folder it names

items.text: The three installed copies of the safe-spawn helper are kept the same bytes.
items.test: tests/safe-spawn.test.mjs::the three installed copies of the safe-spawn helper are the same bytes

items.text: kit-report runs gh from node's own folder.
items.test: tests/safe-spawn.test.mjs::kit-report runs gh from node's own folder, never a gh left in the project

items.text: The report scrub runs git from node's own folder.
items.test: tests/safe-spawn.test.mjs::the report scrub reads git from node's own folder, never a git left in the project

items.text: Both installed copies of visuals run git from node's own folder.
items.test: tests/safe-spawn.test.mjs::both installed copies of visuals run git from node's own folder, never a git left in the project

items.text: A spawn check in CI fails on any bare-name launch in an installed kit file that does not start from node's own folder, with no list of exceptions.
items.test: tests/spawn-check.test.mjs::the kit's own installed files hold no bare-name launch outside node's own folder

items.text: The spawn check names each bare-name launch with no safe folder, in every form a kit file writes one.
items.test: tests/spawn-check.test.mjs::the check names each bare-name launch with no safe folder, in every form a kit file writes one

items.text: The spawn check passes a launch from node's own folder, a full path, the helper, and text that only names a call.
items.test: tests/spawn-check.test.mjs::the check passes a launch from node's own folder, a full path, the helper, and text that only names a call

items.text: The spawn check reads code only, blanking comments and the inside of literals and keeping every line.
items.test: tests/spawn-check.test.mjs::the mask keeps every offset and line, and blanks only comments and the inside of literals

items.text: The spawn check scans project/ and user/, names each file and line, and fails until none is left.
items.test: tests/spawn-check.test.mjs::the command scans project/ and user/ of a kit root, names each file and line, and fails until none is left

items.text: A push marked as the owner's (KIT_OWNER_PUSH) needs the owner's pop-up yes for each ref; a script that clears the session markers can no longer push main.
items.test: tests/guards-hold.test.mjs::a script a Claude session writes and runs cannot clear its markers and push main as the owner

items.text: The state decide command reads and deletes its from file only inside the project.
items.test: tests/state.test.mjs::decide --from refuses a file outside the project and keeps it; a file inside is recorded and removed

items.text: The decide command refuses a from file reached through a junction.
items.test: tests/state.test.mjs::decide --from refuses a file reached through a junction and keeps it

items.test: tests/guards-hold.test.mjs::a Yes whose pop-up record changed shape is still refused, and the refusal names the changed record

items.test: tests/guards-hold.test.mjs::a quoted pattern beside a folder glob reads, and a quoted or dotted name of a guard file is still refused

items.test: tests/guards-hold.test.mjs::rg, find, echo, date and npm ls read as plain readers, and their writing or running forms are still refused

items.test: tests/guards-hold.test.mjs::a program piped into a reader after a cd keeps the folder, and a writer taking the pipe is still refused

items.text: A wildcard in inline node code that can reach no file is read as text; code that lists, writes or runs is still read strictly.
items.test: tests/guards-hold.test.mjs::a wildcard in inline node code that reaches no file is text, and code that lists or writes files is still held

items.text: One wildcard over many folders (du -sh node_modules/*) is no longer held for the folder count.
items.test: tests/guards-outside.test.mjs::one wildcard over many folders runs; a project among them, or a later wildcard read from them, still holds

items.text: The link test skips where Windows gives no symlink rights, instead of failing.
items.test: tests/run-records-kept.test.mjs::filling a probe user layer never writes through a link to a file outside it

verification: Worktree config on Windows: the kit's own test fails at 1.48.0 on the owner's PC and passes here; a new test fails on the 1.48.0 start script and on a session-PATH version, and passes here.

A throwaway install of this branch (worktree config on, 70 folders): plain reads, the K154 and K252 shapes and git status run through the installed chain; a guard write, a globbing write and a push to main are held.
The spawn check reports 0 unsafe bare-name launches, down from 45; both guard self-checks pass (779 and 301 cases).

decisions.decision: The launcher gets Git for Windows' own folder, not the session's PATH
decisions.why: Handing over the session PATH would let a planted git answer the guards' questions (the commit security review).

decisions.decision: A wildcard in inline node code is text only where the code can reach no file
decisions.why: The owner picked the narrow fix over a named limit (2026-11-21); code that lists, writes or runs keeps the strict reading.

decisions.decision: An owner push marker needs a pop-up yes per ref
decisions.why: The owner's option A (2026-11-21): a script that clears the markers could push main.
New holds, a new commit check and a new CI check reach every project.

upgrading: Run install user, then install project: the guard start script, the commit-msg hook and the safe-spawn helper copies change. A project that sets KIT_OWNER_PUSH now gets a pop-up per ref.
limits: Inline code can still build a path from pieces no guard reads; the narrow K154 reading trusts only code with no file, list or run call. A rules file the base does not hold is read from the main checkout, as before.
